# CANDIDATE: STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND

**Filed:** 2026-06-26
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** quality_gate
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We aim to capture edge by avoiding wrong-way trades: bear PUT entries during confirmed 5m uptrends and CALL entries during confirmed 5m downtrends. This edge exists because trading against the intraday trend (as defined by 5m same-day trend classification) tends to produce losing trades, and filtering them out improves overall P&L without affecting the anchor J days (where the trend is often range or the signal is not wrong-way).

## Mechanism

Entry: The engine's existing entry signals are gated by a trend veto. We compute the 5m same-day trend using `crypto.lib.market_structure.classify_trend`. If the trend is uptrend, we block PUT entries; if the trend is downtrend, we block CALL entries; if the trend is range or unknown, we allow the entry (no-veto). Exit: All exit logic (chart stop, profit-lock, premium stop, time stop) remains unchanged from the base engine.
